agents-md-guidances.title: AGENTS.md Guidances
agents-md-guidances.shortDescription: Generate a complete AGENTS.md for a .NET repository, usable by Copilot, Cursor, Codex and Claude Code.
agents-md-guidances.description: A prompt to hand to a coding agent so it produces an AGENTS.md file tailored to your .NET repository.

content.introduction: AGENTS.md became in 2026 the open convention for describing a repository to coding agents: a single file at the root, read by Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Claude Code and others. This prompt guides an agent to explore your .NET repository and produce a complete AGENTS.md rather than a generic skeleton.
content.sources: Sources: AGENTS.md convention and field feedback
useCases: New .NET repository: produce the initial AGENTS.md before handing the first ticket to an agent, so it does not guess build and test commands.
Legacy codebase takeover: have the agent surface the conventions actually applied in the code, then decide what to keep and what to fix.
Monorepo: generate a root AGENTS.md plus one file per significant sub-project, the closest file to the edited code taking precedence.
Human onboarding: the resulting file also works as an entry sheet for a new developer, shorter and more actionable than a README.
Tool migration: move from .cursorrules or .github/copilot-instructions.md to the AGENTS.md convention, read by every agent.
Fewer review round trips: encode in the file the remarks that keep coming back in pull requests.
